0022600120.text: The Cavaliers, who are 0-1 and 11th in the East, host the Minnesota Timberwolves, who are 2-0 and sit 6th in the West, with Cleveland coming off a road loss and looking for its first win of the season. The two teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not yet met in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 146-134 Cavaliers win in Cleveland on January 10, 2026. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, while the Cavaliers have no listed absences.
